seed_random_generator: seed the random number generator with a given integer seed value for reproducibility
generate_uniform_samples: generate uniform random samples in a specified size with torch._numpy.random.random_sample
generate_normal_samples: generate normally distributed random samples with a given mean and standard deviation
generate_integer_samples: generate random integers within a specified low and high range with a given size
shuffle_tensor_in_place: shuffle a tensor in-place by generating a random permutation of its first dimension
